sloka: त्वम् कर्म कृतवान् एतत् काल उपहत चेतनः ।जीवित अंतकरम् घोरम् रामात् व्यसनम् आप्नुहि ॥३-४९-२८॥
transliteration: tvam karma kṛtavān etat kāla upahata cetanaḥ ।jīvita aṁtakaram ghoram rāmāt vyasanam āpnuhi ॥3-49-28॥

translations.english: Time has taken a toll of your senses. This has made you do what you have done. A great calamity is awaiting you in the hands of Rama. It will end your life.
